liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Eyes Of The World** (1 review): The song featured a fine opening jam before the first verse [20]

## The recordings

- **gd1990-07-08.138704.5-1.tobin.flac1648** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 187 min [1]
- **gd1990-07-08.nak300.holtz.lmpp.97714.sbeok.flac16**: audience recording; 22 songs; 185 min; rated 4.75/5 by 24 [5]
- **gd1990-07-08.149331.DAK-OTS.boedicker.flac1644**: source not stated; 21 songs; 182 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [14]
- **gd90-07-08.sbd.brame.16157.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 19 songs; 159 min; rated 3.53/5 by 19 [16]. Said about its sound: The recording contains numerous drops and cuts, suggesting a poor download quality; The recording speed is off, playing too fast; not worth it unless for completion [21][25]
- **gd1990-07-08.135742.set2.sbd.jc.flac24**: soundboard; 11 songs; 95 min [17]

## Around the show

- A dancing skeleton rose from rafters during Estimated Prophet; hot air balloon rose over stadium [23]
- Police were anxious for the crowd to leave after the band tore the building down [23]
- Listener experienced an alien abduction sensation, losing body control and mind during the song [27]
- Crosby, Stills, and Nash opened the show before the Grateful Dead appeared on stage [29]
- Friend convinced listener to go at last minute; they broke down driving six hours home [30]
- Grateful Dead members sat at stage side, laughing and clapping while Crosby, Stills, and Nash played [5]
- Reviewer claims this performance dwarfs any Grateful Dead show from the 1970s era [19]
- Band was totally different from the previous show at Cardinal Stadium in Louisville [29]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1990-07-08.138704.5-1.tobin.flac1648**: transferred by 5.1 LPCM Surround Sound Mix (48k) by Kevin Tobin; source: flac16/48kHz ; 5.1 LPCM Surround Sound (48k) - SBD (shnid = 16157) SBD> C(?)> CDR; via Joey B; encoded by T. Brame; missing encore + AUD (shnid = 130548)… [1]. Also: Mixed by an archive.org user; FLAC conversion done June 30, 2017 by Trader Little Helper [1]
- **gd1990-07-08.nak300.holtz.lmpp.97714.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Greg Holtz; transferred by Brian Green and SIRMick; source: aud > Nakamichi CM-300 mics with CP-4 Shotgun Caps > Sony D-5 > mac [5]. Also: VFTV soundtrack patched tape flips and dropouts; seamless change between discs 2 and 3 [5]
- **gd1990-07-08.149331.DAK-OTS.boedicker.flac1644**: taped by Dave Boedicker; transferred by Dave Boedicker; source: Source:DAK Shotgun Mics>Sony WM-D6C Cassette Deck>2 Maxell MX-89 Minute Metal Master Cassette Tapes>Sony TC-D5 M Cassette Deck(Playback)>Edirol R-09 HR(24/44.1… [14]. Also: Tape flips occurred after Mexicali Blues and Black Peter, with smooth fades noted [14]
- **gd90-07-08.sbd.brame.16157.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD> C(?)> CDR [16]
- **gd1990-07-08.135742.set2.sbd.jc.flac24**: transferred by jchastain; source: SBD: ? > cassette/4 (John) > Sony TC-R303 > Zoom h4n > Audition 1.5 > > TLH [17]. Also: Tapes from a Craigslist collection; cassette generation based on insert; thanks to John and arfarf [17]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by thecurtainwithblog.blogspot.com: [Grateful Dead - 1990-07-08 Three Rivers Stadium, Pittsburgh, PA](https://thecurtainwithblog.blogspot.com/2018/06/grateful-dead-1990-07-08-three-rivers.html) [33]
- Fan art by www.gdao.org: [Tapers' section at Three Rivers Stadium · Grateful Dead Archive Online · Grateful Dead Archive Online](https://www.gdao.org/items/show/826582) [34]

claims.text: Reviewer claims this performance dwarfs any Grateful Dead show from the 1970s era
The song featured a fine opening jam before the first verse
The recording contains numerous drops and cuts, suggesting a poor download quality
A dancing skeleton rose from rafters during Estimated Prophet; hot air balloon rose over stadium
Police were anxious for the crowd to leave after the band tore the building down
The recording speed is off, playing too fast; not worth it unless for completion
Listener experienced an alien abduction sensation, losing body control and mind during the song
Band was totally different from the previous show at Cardinal Stadium in Louisville
Crosby, Stills, and Nash opened the show before the Grateful Dead appeared on stage
Friend convinced listener to go at last minute; they broke down driving six hours home
Mixed by an archive.org user; FLAC conversion done June 30, 2017 by Trader Little Helper
Grateful Dead members sat at stage side, laughing and clapping while Crosby, Stills, and Nash played
VFTV soundtrack patched tape flips and dropouts; seamless change between discs 2 and 3
Tape flips occurred after Mexicali Blues and Black Peter, with smooth fades noted
Tapes from a Craigslist collection; cassette generation based on insert; thanks to John and arfarf
